# ClearUX — AI-Powered UX Audit Platform

> ClearUX is a SaaS platform that runs comprehensive UX audits on any website. It analyses 64 checkpoints across 16 categories grouped into 4 pillars, generating professional reports with severity-ranked findings and actionable recommendations.

## What ClearUX does

ClearUX crawls a website and uses AI to evaluate its user experience across 64 checkpoints. The result is a detailed audit report with an overall score (0-100), category breakdowns, and prioritised findings with severity levels (critical, high, medium, low). Reports include executive summaries, evidence-based findings, and downloadable PDF/Word exports.

## The 4 pillars (16 categories, 64 checkpoints)

1. Foundation: First impressions, messaging clarity, navigation flow, conversion paths
2. Human Experience: Ethical UX, dark pattern detection, psychological safety, cognitive accessibility
3. Inclusive Design: WCAG compliance, mobile responsiveness, keyboard navigation, universal access
4. Future Readiness: AI discoverability, agent navigation, cultural sensitivity, global reach

## Key features

- 64-checkpoint AI-powered UX analysis
- Results delivered in under 10 minutes
- Severity-ranked findings with evidence and recommendations
- Score tracking across re-audits to measure improvement
- Focused re-audits: choose which pillars to re-audit
- Shareable read-only report links (no account needed for viewers)
- PDF and Word report downloads
- First audit free, no credit card required

## Who it is for

- Product teams evaluating their own products
- UX designers and researchers conducting audits
- Agencies auditing client websites
